title: gpbiometricspy: Python tools for Gazepoint biometric workflows
description: gpbiometricspy is the Python counterpart of frozen gpbiometrics 2.0.0. The 0.1.9 maintenance candidate preserves the established public scientific API and documents the October 2026 experimental physiological-validation research with original synthetic figures. The research-only modules in research/october_2026 are not automatically installed from PyPI, and external EDABE/AICOS-HAR and device-reference validity remain unqualified (GitHub issue #176). Historical 0.1.8 empirical and coverage figures must not be interpreted as 0.1.9 evidence; exact-release CI independently checks the candidate.
